title: A vet clinic group whose services state different access checks
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #2054, phase 2). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: The case exists for issue #2054. It measures the assertion pass on the authorization-scope predicates. The source states each part on its own element: the clinic API checks that a pet belongs to the owner (ownership yes), checks only the sign-in for staff requests (each request no, for staff) and gives every staff account every permission (least privilege no); it uses the database's admin account (least privilege no, on that connection). The lab results importer does not check which clinic a result is for or whether the lab may send it (each request no), and the billing service's role check is a hedge that must stay unknown. The tampering must-find rests on the importer's two stated missing checks. The elevation-of-privilege must-find rests on the staff accounts' stated full access. The domain is a vet clinic group, which no other case covers.
